'''Keiko Han''' (Japanese: '''潘恵子''' ''Han Keiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Han was born on April 5, 1953, in {{wp|Shinbashi}}, {{wp|Minato, Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She became a voice actress as an adult and led a prolific voice acting career since the mid-1970s. She was once affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}, but is now affiliated with {{wp|81 Produce}}. Han became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|OS}}, voicing [[Professor Ivy]] of the [[Orange Islands]]. She is of Taiwanese descent and has one child, a daughter named [[Megumi Han|Megumi]], who is also a voice actress. In her spare time, Han is an astrologer and fortune teller of Western {{wp|horoscope}}s.
